email.subject: Could you connect me with the right Medtronic contact?
email.body:
Hi John,

Would you be willing to make a warm introduction to the right person at Medtronic to discuss our Master of Health Science program? I’m hoping to recruit clinicians and scientists, and your Yale leadership in interventional cardiology, along with your role as site PI on Medtronic studies and recent work with Medtronic scientists, makes your perspective especially helpful.

If there’s someone in education, talent development, or academic engagement you’d recommend, an introduction would be greatly appreciated.

Best,
[Your name]
